(馮錫根) 30, native of Wusih, N.F.A.

Previously I was employed by Cotton Mill. My father
died when I was 4 years old. Owing to financial difficulties,
my mother brought me to Shanghai, entering the E-Wo Cotton Mill
as an apprentice at my 7 years of age, where she was engaged too.
We worked at the Cotton Mill, above, for about 10 years, I was
then 17 years old, and my mother died. I became, at that time,
the only one in my family. I then entered the New E-Wo Cotton
Mill, Yangtzepoo, as a workman for the period of 6 or 7 years.
At 24 years of age, I left Shanghai for Wusih and
entered the Sung Sing 3rd Cotton Mill (申新第三紗廠), Wusih, offer-
ing myself as a repairer for machines.
On the approach to Shanghai of the Nationalist Army,
one named Zang Woo Shang (常扣南), workman of the above Mill,
began to be a member of the Communists' Party, during the
trouble between China and Great Britian on 30th May. He
immediately had the 'Club for Workmen' organized at Weissan-
pang (惠山浜), Wusih. He was the Chairman of the Club and I
was a clerk.
On arrival at Shanghai of the Nationalist Army, the
General Association of Workers was organized there. I was
then ordered to be an inspector for that Association, where
I got 40 cents a day as my salary. I left that post 5 or 6
days after, as I was afraid that the job was not proper,
while Zang Woo Shang was working there as Secretary. I was
then engaged by Hu Sung Cotton Mill (厚生紗廠) for about two
years and my resignation was made due to the fact of a quarrel
arising between our workers, at 28 years of age.

此前我受雇于棉纺厂。我4岁时父亲去世。由于经济困难，母亲带我来到上海，我7岁时进入怡和纱厂当学徒，她也在该厂做工。我们在上述棉纺厂工作了约10年，那时我17岁，母亲去世。当时，我是家里唯一的人。随后我进入杨树浦的新怡和纱厂当了6或7年的工人。
24岁时，我离开上海前往无锡，进入无锡申新第三纱厂，自荐担任机器修理工。
当国民革命军逼近上海时，该厂一名叫常扣南（Zang Woo Shang）的工人开始成为共产党员，这是在5月30日中英纠纷期间。他立即在无锡惠山浜组织了“工人俱乐部”。他是俱乐部主席，我是书记员。
国民革命军到达上海后，那里组织了总工会。我当时被任命为该总工会的视察员，每天薪水40分。5或6天后我离开了那个职位，因为我担心这份工作不合适，而常伍尚在那里担任秘书。随后我被厚生纱厂雇佣了约两年，28岁时因工人之间发生争吵而辞职。

As I was unemployed, I resided at Zang Woo Shang's home, Yangtszepoo Jan. He (Zang) then asked me to enter the Communists' Party so as to keep my daily expenses, and I agreed to his suggestion. I started to carry on my work organizing a Branch Association of Workers at Yangtszepoo. I went to entrances of the Cotton Mills every day, where workers were solicited to be members of the Branch Association, above. We held meetings constantly in uncertain places: on the ground or in the straw huts. Money was provided by Zang Woo Shang for the purpose of doing so. Two months later I resigned the job for the lack of money.

I then left Shanghai for Tientsin where I got a position at Yue Yuen Cotton Mill (裕源紗廠) in the capacity of a repairer for machine on my friend named Wee Tsung Hing's (吳振明) recommendation. I worked there for over one year and left because of sickness. I returned to my native place, Wusih, for cure for about 5 or 6 months.

On 12th July, I left Wusih for Shanghai, intending to go to Tientsin again. At 4.p.m. on the day of my arrival at Shanghai, I met one named Woo Foh Shing (吳福興) alias Hu Tung Sheng (吳同聲) on the bus, who, I knew, was a communist. I asked him if he was engaged in any job and he replied no. As we could not talk freely on the bus, I was then asked to go to Room No.20 of Tsing See Lodging House (新蘇旅館), Hupeh Road, on Sunday night. On Sunday, I proceeded to lodging house, above, and met him there. I was arrested when we were talking.

This is my true statement.

Signed and cross marked
by Wong Pao Ding.

因我失业，便居住在杨树浦的臧吾尚（Zang Woo Shang）家中。他（臧）随后为了维持我的日常开销，劝我加入共产党，我同意了他的建议。我开始着手在杨树浦组织一个工人支会的工作。我每天前往各棉纺厂的门口，招募工人加入上述支会。我们在不固定的地点频繁举行会议：有时在露天，有时在草棚里。臧吾尚为此提供了资金。两个月后，因资金匮乏，我辞去了这份工作。

随后我离开上海前往天津，经朋友吴振明（Wee Tsung Hing）推荐，我在裕源纱厂谋得一份机器修理工的职位。我在那里工作了一年多，后因生病离职。我回到家乡无锡治病，历时约五、六个月。

7月12日，我离开无锡前往上海，打算再次去天津。在我抵达上海当天的下午4点，我在公交车上遇到了一位名叫吴福兴（Woo Foh Shing）、别名吴同声（Hu Tung Sheng）的人，据我所知，他是一名共产党员。我问他是否有工作，他回答说没有。由于在公交车上不便自由交谈，他约我于周日晚上到湖北路的新苏旅馆（Tsing See Lodging House）20号房间见面。周日，我前往上述旅馆并在那里见到了他。当我们正在谈话时，我被逮捕了。

这是我的真实供词。

When I was 11 years of age,I entered the Lee Tsi Primary
School in Nanking. My father died when I was 13 years. Owing to
my financial difficulties, I left the school and obtained a job
as an apprentice in a certain factory at Nantao. After a lapse
of half a year, I was employed in the Dong Chong Cotton Factory.
At 18 years of age, I worked as a coolie in the Koong Yih
Cotton factory,Zan Ka Doo. After working there for 5 years, I
was an engineer and a year later, I again obtained a job as an
engineer in the Sun Sing Cotton Mill.
When I was 26 years old, a Great disturbance was made between
China and British on the 30th of May,14th year of the Republic
of China. During the trouble, a strike of labourers had been
started among all the factories. At that time,a man named Lee Lih
San formed a General Labourers Union in which I was a clerk. About
3 or 4 months after the trouble was settled and all labourers and
workers resumed their work, I begun to work in the Sun Sing Cotton
Mill. I was arrested by Seang Wu Garrison H'quarters and
sentenced to 6 months for attending a meeting,which was held in
the 'Keeng Open Tien Yoch Zang' on    day of Sept.15th year of
Chinese Republic. I was released in the beginning of the 16th
year of the Republic of China. I resigned my job when I was 31
years old. I was employed as a broker after having sold my shop.
In the middle of June this year,I was introduced by Zing Chuen Hyi
to a detective named Tsen Kya Yih attached to B.of Public Safety.
To whom I acted as an informer,to enquire into communistic
matters. At 2 p.m.on 12-7-32,I met Lee Sih Kung on a No.10 Bus
I know that he is a communist. I reported same to the detective
that the man Lee is wanted. Before reporting to the detective
I told the man Lee to engage a room No.30 in the Sing See San
lodging house. At 5 p.m.on 17-7-32,Lee Sih Kung was arrested
when he jumped out of the window,causing his leg broken.
                                        Woo Dong Sung.

我11岁时进入南京的李子小学（Lee Tsi Primary School）读书。我13岁时父亲去世。由于经济困难，我辍学并在南市的一家工厂当学徒。半年后，我被东崇棉厂（Dong Chong Cotton Factory）雇用。18岁时，我在闸北的公益棉厂（Koong Yih Cotton factory）做苦力。在那里工作了5年后，我成为了一名技工，一年后，我又在申新棉厂（Sun Sing Cotton Mill）找到了一份技工的工作。
26岁那年，即民国十四年（1925年）5月30日，中英之间发生了重大骚乱（五卅惨案）。在动乱期间，所有工厂的工人都发起了罢工。当时，一位名叫李立三（Lee Lih San）的人组建了总工会，我在其中担任文员。动乱平息、所有劳工和工人复工约三、四个月后，我开始在申新棉厂工作。民国十五年（1926年）9月__日，我因参加在“京开天药庄”（'Keeng Open Tien Yoch Zang'，原文不清/音译）举行的会议，被淞沪卫戍司令部逮捕，并被判处六个月监禁。我在民国十六年（1927年）初获释。31岁时，我辞去了工作。卖掉店铺后，我受雇成为一名经纪人。
今年六月中旬，经郑全义（Zing Chuen Hyi，音译）介绍，我结识了公安局附属的一名侦探曾嘉义（Tsen Kya Yih，音译）。我充当他的线人，调查共产主义相关事务。1932年7月12日下午2点，我在10路公交车上遇到了李思恭（Lee Sih Kung，音译）。我知道他是一名共产党员。我向该侦探报告此人系被通缉者。在向侦探报告之前，我告诉李某在新苏三旅馆（Sing See San lodging house，音译）预订30号房间。1932年7月17日下午5点，李思恭在跳窗时被捕，导致腿部骨折。
                                        吴东松（Woo Dong Sung）。

Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 18/7/32.

Arrest of two communist suspects

At the request of representatives of the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau, the Municipal Police at 5.30 p.m. July 17 raided
Room No.20 Tsing Soo (新苏) Lodging House, 269 Ying Tsung
Faung (迎春坊) off Hupeh Road, and arrested two communist suspects
named Hyui Se Kung (徐锡根) alias Wong Pao Ding (王保定) and
Hu Tung Sheng (胡同声). When the Police entered the room in
question, the first accused attempted to escape by jumping
through a window. He fell some 18 feet to the concrete pavement
below and sustained injuries necessitating his removal to the
Police Hospital where he is now detained.

As no communist literature was found either in the room
or on the arrested persons, they will be detained on a writ
of detention pending an application for their extradition being
made by the Chinese Authorities on July 18.

1932年7月18日的情报日报摘录。

逮捕两名共产主义嫌疑犯

应上海公安局代表的请求，市政警察于7月17日下午5点30分突袭了湖北路迎春坊269号的新苏（Tsing Soo）旅馆20号房间，并逮捕了两名涉嫌共产主义的嫌疑人，分别是徐锡根（Hyui Se Kung），别名王保定（Wong Pao Ding），以及胡同声（Hu Tung Sheng）。当警察进入该房间时，第一名被告试图跳窗逃跑。他从约18英尺高处跌落到下面的混凝土路面上，受伤严重，不得不被送往警务处医院，目前正拘押于此。

由于在房间内或被捕人员身上均未发现任何共产主义宣传品，他们将凭拘留令被羁押，等待中国当局于7月18日提出引渡申请。
